where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://pro.edgex.exchange   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Sign up or log in to edgeX Open edgeX and use Sign Up / Log In. Any existing account holder is already enrolled in Trade to Earn, with no separate registration.
2 Step 2 : Check that your location is supported edgeX restricts access from the US and some other locations. Confirm your access before you fund anything.

3 Step 3 : Fund your account and trade a supported market Deposits go to your own wallet first, then you authorize the move to your trading account. Each qualifying fill then earns a reward based on its eligible fee.

4 Step 4 : Track USDC, locked EDGE and boxes Claimable USDC and locked EDGE appear in your rewards dashboard, and box progress shows on the Mystery Box page . The reward shown at order confirmation is only an estimate until the fill settles.
